items.q: Is it really free for 3 months?
items.a: Yes. Every new account gets full Premium access free for 90 days. No credit card required to start.

items.q: How accurate is the ATS analysis?
items.a: It reads resumes the way applicant tracking systems do — parsing structure, keywords and formatting — then scores your match against the specific job description you paste in.

items.q: Will the ATS analysis work for any job?
items.a: Yes. Paste any job description and your resume, and you get a match score, missing keywords, and section-by-section fixes.
You keep access to your data and can continue on a paid plan (Starter/Professional/Premium) or a limited free tier.
